info.title: CashCtrl API
info.description: Unofficial OpenAPI description of the CashCtrl REST API, generated from the published HTML reference. Request parameters come from the docs; response schemas are inferred from live read-only calls and are therefore best-effort. CashCtrl publishes no official spec.

basicAuth.description: API key as the username; leave the password empty.

get.description: Returns the balance of a single account for the given date.

200.description: Success. Note that write endpoints return 200 even when validation fails; check `success`.

notes.description: Some optional notes. This can contain limited HTML for styling. isAddStock.description: Whether inventory stock is added with this status. Note that when changing between two statuses that both have isAddStock set, it will only be added once, not twice. isClosed.description: Whether the status closes / completes the order object. This would be the case, for example, if an invoice has been fully paid. endDate.description: The end date for the recurrence (see recurrence parameter). Orders repeat automatically up until this date, when the recurrence will stop. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15 .

groupId.description: The ID of the order group (dossier). Use this to include the order in a dossier with other orders that belong together (e.g. the offer, order confirmation, delivery note and invoice of the same order). This is overridden by previousId (if both are set).

notifyUserId.description: The ID of the user to send a notification to. See notifyType parameter. Note: User must be in this organization.

nr.description: The order number (e.g. 'IN-2001015' for an invoice). Leave empty to generate the number with sequenceNumberId . This becomes mandatory if a sequence number is set neither here nor in the order category.

previousId.description: The ID of the previous order from which this order is created (Next step / Continue as). The new order will be grouped with the previous order in a dossier. See also groupId . This will override groupId (if both are set).

recurrence.description: The interval of how often the order should be automatically repeated. Leave empty to not repeat the order. See also startDate and endDate . Possible values: MONTHLY, WEEKLY, DAILY, YEARLY, SEMESTRAL, QUARTERLY, BI_MONTHLY, BI_WEEKLY.

responsiblePersonId.description: The ID of the responsible person (Sachbearbeiter). See Person .
